name: connectwise-psa
description: ConnectWise PSA (Manage): tickets, companies, contacts, assets, time, projects, procurement, finance and sales. Read tools, gated write tools, and interactive ticket, board, company, time, project and schedule views.
long_description:
ConnectWise PSA (Manage) as a local MCP server. Tickets, companies, contacts, configurations, time and expense entries, projects with phases, the procurement catalog, products and purchase orders, agreements, invoices, opportunities, members, activities and the dispatch schedule, plus board metadata and read/write escape hatches (cw_api_get, cw_api_write) for the rest of the 1,800+ endpoint REST surface.

Every tool is named cw_* and shows a Title Case name in the client. Read tools carry readOnlyHint and can run without a prompt. The interactive views (cw_get_ticket, cw_view_board, cw_view_company, cw_view_time, cw_view_project, cw_view_schedule) render as MCP Apps cards on hosts that support it and as plain JSON everywhere else.

WRITES ARE GATED. Write tools (create and update tickets, ticket notes, time and expense entries, cw_api_write) stay listed but refuse until you turn on PSA write mode; cw_api_write is the disruptive tier and also needs PSA allow destructive. Every write call also carries confirm: true. cw_status_gate explains a refusal, and cw_status_server reports exactly which fields are still empty.

This bundle runs on your own machine and holds the ConnectWise credentials there. Automate ships as a separate bundle from the same repository.

psa_site.title: PSA site
psa_site.description: Your ConnectWise Manage host, e.g. na.myconnectwise.net. The api- prefix is added automatically for cloud hosts.

psa_company_id.title: PSA company id
psa_company_id.description: The company identifier you log in with.

psa_public_key.title: PSA public key
psa_public_key.description: Public key of an API member. Give that member only the permissions these tools need — the connector can create tickets and time entries.

psa_private_key.title: PSA private key
psa_private_key.description: The matching private key. Supply it from your secret manager.

psa_client_id.title: ConnectWise clientId
psa_client_id.description: The developer clientId GUID sent with every request. Issued by ConnectWise; required by the API.

psa_write_mode.title: PSA write mode
psa_write_mode.description: Allow the PSA write tools (create and update tickets, ticket notes, time and expense entries) to change live data. Off by default: write tools stay listed and refuse with a message naming this switch. Every write call also needs confirm: true.

psa_allow_destructive.title: PSA allow destructive
psa_allow_destructive.description: Also allow the disruptive PSA tier: the raw cw_api_write passthrough, which can delete records. Needs PSA write mode on as well.
